question: Why is Krishna's form difficult even for gods to see?
premises: Krishna says this form is very hard to see
Even gods always desire to see it
inference: The divine form is rarely seen, so Arjuna's vision is exceptional.
uncertainties: Fused forms are analyzed as given
plain_english: The blessed Lord said: this form of mine that you have seen is very hard to see; even the gods always desire to see this form.
